Photo 1 is a closer view of the same box and controller, with a yellow sticky note attached to the box.

The sticky note lists: 'PS4 slim with 11 games', followed by a list of game titles: '1. Hustle King, 2. FIFA 20, 3. F1 20, 4. NFS, 5. NFS, 6. NBA, 7. Batman, 8. Tuf is orange, 9. Tuf is black or blue'.

The box is not a standard PS4 box; it is custom camouflaged and wrapped in plastic, suggesting it may be a repackaged or non-original unit.
No visible branding or model text on the box or controller in either photo.
The watermark 'SUCCESS GAMES AND GADGETS' is present on both photos.
